Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing a task force to review and analyze the methodologies and data used by the United States department of justice.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing a task force to review and analyzethe methodologies and data used by the United States department ofjustice in its investigation of the Seattle police department's use offorce policies; and creating new sections.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that use of forceissues are criminal justice and law enforcement matters left to thestates under the Tenth Amendment to the United States Constitution andany use of force policies or practices recommended or imposed by thefederal government, other than those clearly and expressly required orauthorized by an act of congress, are not binding on state and localgovernment agencies.

(1) A task force is hereby created to reviewand analyze the methodologies, statistics, and all other procedures anddata used by the United States department of justice in itsinvestigation of the Seattle police department's use of force policiesto support its findings and conclusions and recommended remedial p. 1 HB 2630measures in its investigation report dated December 16, 2011, andissued by the United States attorney's office for the western districtof Washington. (2) The task force includes representatives from the statelegislature, state and local law enforcement, the Washington statecriminal justice training commission, and the attorney general'soffice. (3) Staff support for the task force shall be provided by senatecommittee services and the house of representatives office of programresearch. (4) Meetings shall take place in Olympia on the capitol campus. (5) Legislative members and nonlegislative members of the taskforce may not be reimbursed for expenses, but shall participate in avoluntary capacity. (6) The task force shall report its findings to the appropriatecommittees of the legislature by December 17, 2012.
